vendor: Airbase Inc. (acquired by Paylocity Corporation, October 2024)
product_family: Spend management and financial operations platform combining bill pay, accounts payable automation, expense management, corporate cards, and procurement capabilities.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Paylocity engages reputable audit firms who perform annual independent attestations for SOC 1 and SOC 2 Type II, which cover controls related to financial reporting, security, confidentiality, and availability.

certifications.name: SOC 1 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Paylocity engages reputable audit firms who perform annual independent attestations for SOC 1 and SOC 2 Type II, which cover controls related to financial reporting, security, confidentiality, and availability.

certifications.name: ISO 27001:2022
certifications.proof_quote: Paylocity is ISO 27001:2022 certified, which is an internationally recognized framework that demonstrates controls in data security and risk management and continuous improvement in protecting sensitive information.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Paylocity commits to compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), and other US and international privacy or data protection laws.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No vendor-domain statement asserting PCI DSS compliance was found. The vendor's own pages reference PCI DSS requirements but do not publicly claim certification. The only affirmative 'PCI Compliant' assertion comes from a third-party profile, which also over-claims FedRAMP for Airbase and is not reliable evidence.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No vendor-domain statement confirms HIPAA compliance or BAA availability for the Airbase spend product. A 2023 third-party assessment (Paubox) found no BAA capability on Airbase's site. Post-acquisition, Paylocity signs BAAs at the parent level, but product-level coverage for the Airbase spend platform is not publicly documented.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No evidence found in FedRAMP marketplace or official vendor documentation. Nudge Security profile claims 'FedRAMP Compliant' but this is unverified and does not appear in official FedRAMP Marketplace product listings.

certifications.name: CSA STAR Level 1
certifications.proof_quote: No public vendor-domain evidence of CSA STAR Level 1 registration or certification was found on the vendor's trust center or security pages. The only assertion comes from a third-party profile, which also over-claims FedRAMP for Airbase and is not reliable evidence.

flags: A third-party profile claims Airbase is 'FedRAMP Compliant,' but no evidence is found in the FedRAMP Marketplace or official vendor documentation. Neither Airbase nor Paylocity appears to be FedRAMP authorized.

The SOC 1, SOC 2 Type II, and ISO 27001 certifications are held by Paylocity, the parent company, not by Airbase as a separate entity. The airbase.com pages now redirect to paylocity.com. These are Paylocity parent-company certifications that cover the Airbase-by-Paylocity product.

A third-party profile claims Airbase has HIPAA compliance, but an independent assessment (Paubox, March 2023) found no mention of BAA capability on Airbase's public site. Post-acquisition, Paylocity signs BAAs at the parent level, but product-level BAA availability for the Airbase spend platform is not publicly confirmed.

Paylocity completed its acquisition of Airbase on October 1, 2024. The vendor is now 'Airbase, a Paylocity Company.' Certifications shown are the parent's (Paylocity) and are presumed to cover the Airbase product; product-specific scoping is not separately published.
